title: Surreal Cracked Kitchen Vision
description: A woman in a green dress stands in a dilapidated kitchen with green cabinets and a yellow refrigerator, holding a comedy mask. A large stained glass window with three eyes and geometric patterns emits green and purple light rays. The wall is cracked open revealing a surreal landscape with a red sun, floating figures, and multiple floating faces with third eyes.
prompt: A surreal painting of a woman in an emerald green dress standing in a decaying green kitchen with a yellow refrigerator and black sink, holding a white comedy mask. A large stained glass window shows three all-seeing eyes in geometric purple, green and yellow patterns emitting light rays. The wall is dramatically cracked open revealing a cosmic scene with a red sun, a walking astronaut figure, and multiple floating faces with third eyes, in a symbolic and eerie style.
